name: Arrowhold
summary:
Arrowhold is tower defence with a real bow. A toy-sized valley rests on a table in front of you, your keep at its near edge and caves at the far end. Skeletons march out along the trails and you stop them before they reach the gate.

Hold the bow out in one hand. Take the string with the other, pull it back toward your face and let go. The further you draw, the further it flies; raise the bow to lob over walls and shields. A dotted arc shows where it will land, and headshots do double damage.

Four worlds,
